name: Lover Trap
steps: “Sorry, I can’t see. Who are you?”
“Sorry, I can’t see, so I can’t help you find the button.”
“Thank you, turns out I’m wearing a yellow skirt.”
“I have a cold, I can’t smell anything.”
“No way, it might be the smell of rust.”
“I’m on a diet recently, so I won’t eat.”
“I don’t see or hear, what happened?”
